# TVS Diode:  SMBJ10A-TR
![[SMB.webp]]
## Specs

- **VRWM (stand-off):** 10 V
- **VBR (breakdown):** 11.1–11.7 V
- **VC (clamp):** 17 V
- **Peak power:** 600 W
- **Type:** UNIDIRECTIONAL

Datasheet: https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/smbj58ca.pdf
### Design Notes: 
- Obviously, place it as physically close to the barrel jack as possible
- Shortest path the GND with very ***thicc*** trace
